provenance.method: Source inspection only; existing numerical verification was not rerun for this infrastructure transcription. External references are inherited from docs/PHYSICS.md and were not independently verified.

components.description: Fixed prescribed shaped boundary and toroidal cell-sum volume.
Five-second programmed current and rectangular auxiliary heating.
Replaceable TransportClosure with heuristic tauE, fixed tauP, effective temperature-dependent resistivity.
Explicit conservative-ledger Euler integration of N, We, Wi.
Two finite-difference SOR basis solves and algebraic current/mean-pressure closure.

interfaces.inputs: Controls plus computed Geometry; optional dt and TransportClosure to runShot. Selected-time equilibrium receives Basis, current in MA, field in T, mean pressure in Pa.
interfaces.outputs: Shot schemaVersion 1, modelVersion 0.1.0; separate equilibrium status/results.
interfaces.coupling: Controls -> fixed geometry/volume and waveforms -> thermal shot -> selected-time mean pressure/current -> equilibrium. No equilibrium feedback.
interfaces.manifests: These science files document existing code and are not loaded by production.
